messages:
maya: Quick sync — Sapphire chipset EAP onboarding. NDA countersigned yesterday by legal. @sahil can you confirm access timeline from infra side? :eyes:
sahil: Confirmed. Partner wants test images by next Tue. We're provisioning an on-prem slot in us-west-2, will finish by EOD today.
maya: Two asks from Sapphire: (1) perf baseline script that runs end-to-end; (2) telemetry hook to export token-level latencies and mem usage.
oliver: I'll drop the baseline script in the repo. Use ./bench/run_sapphire.sh --model redwood-13b --seq 2048 --iters 50
oliver: sample run:
```
./bench/run_sapphire.sh --model redwood-13b --seq 2048 --iters 10
WARMUP: 3 runs
avg latency: 42ms/token
p95: 78ms
```
jenn: For telemetry, we should enable the tracing flag and send to partner's S3 bucket. Add this env in deployment snippet:
```
REDWOOD_TELEMETRY=partner-sapphire
TRACE_SINK=s3://sapphire-eap-telemetry
```
sahil: Note: because this is preview hardware, keep conservative batching to avoid OOMs — set MAX_BATCH=8, MAX_SEQ=2048. Also pin driver to 2.4.1 for stability.
maya: Also partner asked for a privacy note — no customer data leaves the VPC, confirm.
sapphire-eng (partner): Confirmed — all telemetry goes to our S3, access granted only to named engineer ARNs. NDA acknowledged.
maya: Timeline recap: infra slot today, baseline script by @oliver today, bench run by @sahil tomorrow, telemetry config and policy doc by @jenn by EOD Monday. Anyone object?
oliver: ack
sahil: ack
jenn: ack — will include rollback steps and fallback model mapping.
maya: I'll prepare the short internal announcement for legal & marketing to align messaging: "Sapphire EAP limited preview — benchmark collaboration".
maya: Quick follow-up: if we hit perf regression >15% vs our reference baseline, auto-fallback to the quantized variant is allowed per partner SLA — documenting now.
deploy-bot: bench-run started on host sapphire-usw2-01 (job id 6743)
sahil: ping when results posted, will run evallist and upload to /benchmarks/sapphire/1798765432
maya: thanks team :tada:
